name: Meteorology knowledge graph
description: Concepts, variables, formulas, instruments, models, methods, metrics, hazards, data sources and agent steps for a Singapore-focused weather decision agent. Each node links to the chapter that explains it.

nodes.label: Dewpoint
nodes.summary: Temperature at which air saturates when cooled at constant pressure.

nodes.label: Relative humidity
nodes.summary: Ratio of vapour pressure to saturation vapour pressure.

nodes.label: Mixing ratio
nodes.summary: Mass of vapour per mass of dry air.

nodes.label: Specific humidity
nodes.summary: Mass of vapour per mass of moist air.

nodes.label: Virtual temperature
nodes.summary: Temperature of dry air with the same density as the moist air.

nodes.label: Pressure
nodes.summary: Atmospheric pressure; small gradients near the equator.

nodes.label: Potential temperature θ
nodes.summary: Temperature after adiabatic move to 1000 hPa; conserved in dry motion.

nodes.label: Equivalent potential temperature θe
nodes.summary: Includes latent heat; conserved in moist adiabatic motion.

nodes.label: Wind (u, v)
nodes.summary: Wind vector; average components, not directions.

nodes.label: Wind gust
nodes.summary: Max 3-s wind; convective gusts unrelated to mean wind.

nodes.label: Radar reflectivity Z
nodes.summary: Sum of drop diameters to the sixth power.

nodes.label: Brightness temperature
nodes.summary: IR radiance as black-body temperature; cold = tall cloud.

nodes.label: Cloud-top cooling rate
nodes.summary: Rate of IR top cooling; signals growing convection.

nodes.label: Lightning flash rate
nodes.summary: Flashes per minute in a cell; jumps precede severe weather.

nodes.label: Layer thickness
nodes.summary: Height difference between pressure levels; warmer = thicker.

nodes.label: Conditional instability
nodes.summary: Unstable only if saturated: Γ_m < Γ_e < Γ_d.

nodes.label: Lifting condensation level
nodes.summary: Cloud base for a lifted parcel.

nodes.label: Parcel theory
nodes.summary: Lifted parcel compared with environment to judge buoyancy.

nodes.label: Level of free convection
nodes.summary: Height where a lifted parcel becomes buoyant.

nodes.label: Buoyancy
nodes.summary: Upward acceleration from virtual temperature excess.

nodes.label: Entrainment
nodes.summary: Mixing of environmental air into updrafts; dry air weakens them.

nodes.label: Vertical wind shear
nodes.summary: Change of wind with height; controls storm organisation.

nodes.label: Convective ingredients
nodes.summary: Moisture + instability + lift (+ shear for organisation).

nodes.label: Precipitation efficiency
nodes.summary: Fraction of condensate reaching the ground; high in the tropics.

nodes.label: K-index
nodes.summary: Lapse rate + moisture; good tropical thunderstorm indicator.

nodes.label: Precipitable water
nodes.summary: Column water vapour as liquid depth (mm).

nodes.label: Heat index
nodes.summary: Apparent temperature from T and RH (Rothfusz).

nodes.label: WBGT
nodes.summary: Heat stress index used by NEA.

nodes.label: PSI
nodes.summary: Singapore air quality index; max of pollutant sub-indices.

nodes.label: RMM index
nodes.summary: MJO phase and amplitude from two principal components.

nodes.label: Niño 3.4 / ONI
nodes.summary: Central Pacific SST anomaly; ENSO state.

nodes.label: Dipole Mode Index
nodes.summary: West minus south-east Indian Ocean SST anomaly.

nodes.label: Geostrophic wind
nodes.summary: Pressure–Coriolis balance; fails near the equator.

nodes.label: Diurnal pressure tide
nodes.summary: Twice-daily ~1–1.5 hPa oscillation dominating tropical pressure changes.

nodes.label: Sea / land breeze
nodes.summary: Daytime onshore flow; convergence triggers storms.

nodes.label: Urban heat island
nodes.summary: Urban areas warmer, especially at night.

nodes.label: Thunderstorm
nodes.summary: Deep convection with lightning; main heavy-rain producer.

nodes.label: Sumatra squall
nodes.summary: Nocturnal line from Sumatra; pre-dawn–morning gusts and rain.

nodes.label: Monsoon surge
nodes.summary: Strengthened NE monsoon; prolonged widespread rain.

nodes.label: Cold surge
nodes.summary: Cold outbreak from East Asia accelerating NE winds.

nodes.label: Borneo vortex
nodes.summary: Cyclonic circulation near Borneo in NE monsoon.

nodes.label: Equatorial waves
nodes.summary: Kelvin and Rossby waves modulating convection.

nodes.label: ENSO
nodes.summary: El Niño drier/hazier; La Niña wetter for the region.

nodes.label: Tropical cyclone (distant)
nodes.summary: Rarely direct; affects moisture and wind.

nodes.label: NE monsoon (Dec–early Mar)
nodes.summary: Wet early with surges; drier Feb.

nodes.label: Flash flood
nodes.summary: Rapid local flooding from intense short bursts.

nodes.label: Heavy rain
nodes.summary: Intense rain rates; drives flash floods.

nodes.label: Automatic weather station
nodes.summary: Point T, RH, wind, pressure, rain.

nodes.label: Tipping-bucket rain gauge
nodes.summary: Point rainfall; under-catch in heavy rain.

nodes.label: Radiosonde
nodes.summary: Vertical profiles; basis for stability indices.

nodes.label: Weather radar
nodes.summary: Rain intensity and motion every 5–10 min.

nodes.label: Dual-polarisation radar
nodes.summary: ZDR, KDP, ρHV for drop shape and better rain rates.

nodes.label: Numerical weather prediction
nodes.summary: Physics on a grid from an analysis.

nodes.label: Data assimilation
nodes.summary: Combine background and observations into an analysis.

nodes.label: Convection scheme
nodes.summary: Largest tropical error source; early, light, widespread rain.

nodes.label: Convection-permitting model
nodes.summary: ≲4 km grid; explicit storms; use probabilistically.

nodes.label: AI weather model
nodes.summary: GraphCast, GenCast, Pangu, FourCastNet, Aurora, AIFS.

nodes.label: Quality control
nodes.summary: Range, step, persistence, consistency, buddy checks.

nodes.label: Buddy check (MAD)
nodes.summary: Compare with neighbour median using MAD.

nodes.label: Z–R relationship
nodes.summary: Reflectivity to rain rate; 2–3× uncertainty at high dBZ.

nodes.label: Spatial interpolation
nodes.summary: Nearest land point or bilinear; not bilinear for rain.

nodes.label: Quantile mapping
nodes.summary: Map forecast CDF to observed CDF.

nodes.label: EMOS / NGR
nodes.summary: Gaussian predictive distribution from ensemble mean and variance.
nodes.formula: μ = a + b·x̄, σ² = c + d·s²

nodes.label: Isotonic recalibration
nodes.summary: Monotone mapping of raw to observed probability.

nodes.label: Neighbourhood probability
nodes.summary: Fraction of points within radius exceeding threshold.

nodes.label: Probability of precipitation
nodes.summary: Long-run frequency of rain at a point for that forecast.

nodes.label: Sharpness
nodes.summary: Confidence of forecasts; maximise subject to reliability.

nodes.label: Model confidence (classifier)
nodes.summary: A classifier's certainty in its own answer; NOT a weather probability.

nodes.label: Cell tracking
nodes.summary: Track storm objects and their trends.

nodes.label: Arrival time estimate
nodes.summary: Distance / approach speed, as a window.

nodes.label: Convective initiation
nodes.summary: New storm formation; extrapolation can't see it.

nodes.label: Nowcast–NWP blend
nodes.summary: Lead-time weight from nowcast to NWP.

nodes.label: Diurnal cycle
nodes.summary: Daily cycle; strongest single rain predictor in Singapore.

nodes.label: IDF curves
nodes.summary: Rain depth by duration and return period; drainage design.

nodes.label: Contingency table
nodes.summary: Hits, false alarms, misses, correct negatives.

nodes.label: Brier score
nodes.summary: MSE of probabilities; decomposes into reliability, resolution, uncertainty.

nodes.label: Double penalty
nodes.summary: Misplaced storm counted as miss and false alarm.

nodes.label: Bootstrap confidence intervals
nodes.summary: Resample (blocks of) days for score uncertainty.

nodes.label: Economic value
nodes.summary: Savings relative to climatology and perfect forecasts.

nodes.label: Act now or wait
nodes.summary: Wait when p is near threshold and time allows.

nodes.label: data.gov.sg (NEA real-time)
nodes.summary: Rain, T, RH, wind, 2-h forecast, PSI, WBGT, lightning.

nodes.label: Open-Meteo
nodes.summary: Multi-model and ensemble forecasts via JSON.

nodes.label: MSS daily climate files
nodes.summary: Per-station monthly CSVs: daily rain, max 30/60/120-min rain, temperature, wind; Changi from 1991.

nodes.label: MSS radar rain-area images
nodes.summary: 480×480 PNG every 5 min, ~30-day retention, no official API or georeference.

nodes.label: Open-Meteo historical forecasts
nodes.summary: Archived past model forecasts for backtesting the scorecard.

nodes.label: Real data check
nodes.summary: Live probing of sources: formats, history depth, quirks, first baselines and verification.

nodes.label: 1 Router
nodes.summary: Fast typed decisions: intent, urgency, horizon.

nodes.label: 6 Gather forecasts
nodes.summary: Site and neighbourhood values per source.

nodes.label: 11 Explain
nodes.summary: LLM writes from structured object only.

nodes.label: 12 Output check
nodes.summary: Numbers trace to data; no contradictions.

nodes.label: Forecaster workflow
nodes.summary: Observe → diagnose → consult → reconcile → forecast → communicate → verify.

nodes.label: Lead-time regimes
nodes.summary: Right tool per horizon: nowcast to seasonal.
